column1: # BASE/icon2bc contiguous decoder-state ownership pass, checkpoint 06409a9
# Target: IconToBitmapColorTable, RVA 0xd32a0, retail size 0x5af, target relocations 91.

# New evidence: the 17 verified scratch owners occupy one gapless 0x44-byte block at 0x534ca8..0x534ceb. This pass tested real record ownership, not overlapping aliases, and combined it only with the already-proved pre-loop destination lifetime where stated.
# Retail allocation target: setup data=ESI, 13*frame=EBX, entry=EDI, entry.x=ECX, srcOffset=EAX; decoder X=ESI, destination=EBX, source=ECX, command=EAX, count=EDX.
# No regex or AST permutation tool was used. All rejected source/header states were removed.

column5: Separate verified statics; setup folds offset+entry into ECX and loop reloads destination. This remains the retained checkpoint.
An inline reader returning the command still emitted source=EAX/command=ECX; an inline return boundary alone is not the missing abstraction.
One flat 0x44-byte record preserves every retail relocation address/addend, but broad alias and declaration-state changes regress setup/decoder allocation.

The flat record plus the retail destination lifetime uniquely recovers source=ECX, command=EAX, and count=EDX. It keeps X=EBX and destination=ESI, exactly the reverse of retail, and adds one relocation occurrence.
A two-pointer record at 0x534cd4 groups only destination/source. It is too narrow to trigger command ownership and emits source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX/destination=EDX.
A contiguous record for destination/source/shadow-count/X0/color/run at 0x534cd4..0x534ceb remains source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX/destination=EDX.
Byte-offset setup recovers 13*frame=EBX and X=ESI, but colors entry.x=EDI/entry=ECX and flips the decoder back to source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX/destination=EDX.
Declaring the typed entry before its x/srcOffset snapshots folds offset+data into ECX and retains the wrong decoder coloring.
Mutating formal x preserves source=ECX/command=EAX/count=EDX but still leaves X=EBX/destination=ESI and broadly regresses setup.
Nesting the tail command record inside the full state changes compiler state enough to recover X=ESI, but loses command/count ownership and leaves destination=EDX.
Moving the same flat record to a TU-private header after Misc perturbs the prologue/row lifetime broadly and does not recover the retail register chain.

column1: # Follow-up trigger: the whole-flat state proved command coloring but conflated X and destination ownership. Sibling Icon2b has an equally gapless scratch block with a different physical role order (row,pitch,color,palette,run,count,source,...), so contiguity alone is not evidence for one shared record type. The bounded follow-up below tested only independently meaningful contiguous role groups and the setup accessor repeated by retail Icon2b/icon2bc.

column5: Group only the adjacent inclusive bottom/right bounds at 0x534cc4..0x534ccb. It preserves all relocation occurrences, X=ESI, and count=EDX, but keeps source=EAX/command=ECX and reloads destination into EDI.
Combine the same proven bounds pair with retail's pre-loop cursor. X remains ESI, but destination=EDX and source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX; four occurrences disappear.

Group only the contiguous source/shadow-count/initial-X/color/run tail at 0x534cd8..0x534ceb, deliberately leaving the independently loop-carried destination at 0x534cd4 scalar. X remains ESI, but destination=EDX and source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX. This is the closest partial-record state but remains below canonical 73.1690.
Group the contiguous X/Y/entry/row positional context at 0x534cb0..0x534cbf. It also retains X=ESI but leaves destination=EDX and source=EAX/command=ECX/count=EBX.
Explicit register hints on X and destination do not steer MSVC 4.2; bytes are identical to whole_flat_state_preloop_cursor.

A TU-private inline accessor for the sibling-shared packed IconEntry frame calculation preserves target occurrences, but spills the row, assigns X=EBP, and loses the recovered command allocation. No helper symbol is emitted.
